If the raw value for a vocabulary-valued property is not a string,
warn and discard the value.

-- test.glx --
persons:
    person-with-error:
        properties:
            # sex has a vocabulary type (sex_types) and so requires a string value.
            sex: false
    person-well-formed:
        properties:
            sex: unknown

-- want-errors --
persons\[person-with-error\].Properties.sex: value discarded: expected string for "sex_types" vocabulary lookup, got bool
persons\[person-with-error\].Properties.sex: entry discarded: has neither value nor fields
persons\[person-with-error\].Properties.sex: property discarded: no entries

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    person-with-error:
        properties: {} # Ill-formed property discarded.
    person-well-formed:
        properties:
            sex:
                definition:
                    label: Sex
                    vocabulary_type: sex_types
                entries:
                -   value:
                        value: unknown
                        definition:
                            label: Unknown
